editorial:
Imagine walking out of prison and having only one goal: finding the guy you love. That is exactly where you start with this gritty story set in the rough streets of Barcelona. You get to follow a young woman who is totally obsessed with Gumer, her old boyfriend. The city feels alive and dangerous, filled with drug deals and street life. You will also meet Charo, a loyal best friend who is stuck working for a mean pimp named Toni. It is a messy, emotional ride where the characters are just trying to survive in a world that does not want them to win.

What really hits home is how the characters stick together when things get bad. The acting feels real and the tension builds up as they try to start their own business to get away from the bad guys. Some parts of the movie move a bit slow, but the payoff is worth it. If you like crime stories with a lot of heart, you should definitely check this one out. To get the best experience, try to find a 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection so you can see all the gritty details of the city, or look for it to rent on Apple TV.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the group tries to break away from the criminal world. After forming their own gang to make money, the tension with the old bosses reaches a breaking point. You see the characters face the consequences of their choices in a harsh world. Some find a way to escape the cycle of crime, while others get pulled back in, showing that leaving the street life is almost impossible in a city like this.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves raw street dramas and stories about loyalty.
